newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells 4.603 bln reais in Treasury Letters.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells 4.603 bln reais in Treasury Letters.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank, on behalf of the National Treasury, raised 4.603 billion reais during an auction of two series of National Treasury Letters know as LTNs, dealers said.
A total of 3.618 billion reais of 181-day LTNs, due in July 15 1997, was sold at an overnight call money rate of 2.47 percent a month.
The Central Bank also sold 985 million reais of 365-day LTNs, due in January 15, 1998, at a call money rate of 2.35 percent a month.
Dealers said the results of the auction were in line with market expectations.
